title: hYYa Digital Footprint Check
shortDescription: Bona okwaziwa izinhlelo, hlola izimvume, ukulungise kancane kancane ngasese.
fullDescription:
Kumahhala ngo-100%: azikho izikhangiso, akukho okuthengwayo ngaphakathi kohlelo lokusebenza.

Izinhlelo zakho zokusebenza zingazi okuningi kakhulu ngawe kunalokho ocabanga ngakho. I-hYYa Digital Footprint Check ikubonisa lokho ezingakubona, lokho okunokufinyelela okukhethekile, nokuthi ungakulungisa kanjani ngamazwi alula.

IZINYATHELO EZINE EZILULA
1. Footprint: ukuthinta kanye nje kuhlola lokho noma yiluphi uhlelo lokusebenza olungakufunda mayelana nedivayisi yakho.
2. Sensitive apps: bona ukuthi yiziphi izinhlelo zakho zokusebenza abanye abangazibona, njengezinhlelo zokuthandana, ezokukholwa, ezempilo noma ze-VPN, nokuthi lokho kungathini ngawe.
3. Tracker: bona ukuthi yiziphi izinhlelo zokusebenza ezingafunda isikrini sakho, zifunde zonke izaziso, noma zivale idivayisi yakho. Izinhlelo eziphethe ngaphezu kokukodwa kwalokhu ziyamakwa, ngoba yilokho izinhlelo zokulandelela ezisebenza ngakho. Bese uvula irekhodi le-Android uqobo elibonisa izinhlelo ezisebenzise indawo yakho, ikhamera nemakrofoni.
4. Check-up: landela izinyathelo ezilula njengezibuyekezo, ukuqalisa kabusha kwamasonto onke nokuhlola amaphasiwedi avunyelwe, bese ungena ohlwini lwezilungiselelo (Settings) ingxenye eyodwa ngesikhathi ukuze ubuyise izimvume ongathandi ukuzinikeza.

ISIKOLO ESISODWA KUKHO KONKE OKUNE
Isikolo sakho sobumfihlo, kokungama-100, sihlanganisa lokhu kuhlola okune. Uma siphezulu kungcono kakhulu, futhi siyakhula njengoba uqeda ukuhlola ngakunye. Faka i-widget ukuze ubone isikolo sakho nokuhlola kwakho kokugcina ngokubheka nje kanyekanye.

KULUNGISE NAMI
Thinta okuthi "Fix them with me" bese uhlelo lokusebenza lukuhola ekulungiseni ngakunye, ngakunye ngesikhathi, likusiza ukuthola izilungiselelo (Settings) ezifanele ngokushesha. Bese uhlola futhi ubuke isikolo sakho sikhuphuka.

KUCACILE, KUZOLILE FUTHI KUTHEMBEKILE
• Ishadi lemibala ekhasini ngalinye: okubomvu kudinga ukubhekwa, okuphuzi kuhle ukukwazi, okuluhlaza kulungile.
• Konke okutholakele ngamazwi alula: isihloko esifushane, umugqa owodwa wokuthi kungani kubalulekile, nokuthi ungakulungisa kanjani.
• Izinhlelo zokusebenza ezakhelwe ngaphakathi kudivayisi yakho azinakwa njengeziyingozi, kanti izinhlelo zokulawula zabazali noma zomsebenzi zibizwa ngalokho eziyikho.
• Ukwethembeka kokuthi "yi-Google kuphela noma umenzi wedivayisi ongalungisa lokhu" uma kungekho ongakwenza.
• Isikhumbuzi samasonto onke noma senyanga sokuhlola futhi, uma uthanda.

UKWAZIWA NOMA USUSULE UHLELO LOKUSEBENZA
I-Android inikeza izinhlelo zokusebenza zenkampani ngayinye ikhodi ehlala ifana noma ngabe uyazisusa uphinde uzifake kabusha. Bona eyakho, nokuthi kungani ukusetha kabusha kwasembonini kuphela okungayishintsha.

KUKLANYELWE UKUVIKELA UBUMFIHLO
• Ayikho imvume ye-inthanethi: uhlelo lokusebenza alukwazi ukuxhuma noma kuphi, ngakho-ke akukho okushiya idivayisi yakho.
• Ayikho i-akhawunti, azikho izikhangiso, akukho ukulandelela.
• Kumahhala. Akukho okuthengwayo, akukho okubhaliselwayo.
• Umthombo ovulekile (open source), ukuze noma ubani akwazi ukuhlola indlela olusebenza ngayo.

Hlangana nomsentshisi: usekhasini ngalinye futhi unokusikisela uma umthinta.

I-hYYa Digital Footprint Check iyingxenye yomndeni we-hYYa wezinhlelo zokusebenza ezibeka ubumfihlo phambili.
releaseNotes: Lokhu kukhishwa kuqukethe ukulungiswa kwamaphutha ajwayelekile nokuthuthukiswa kokuzinza.
